profile.headline: Software Engineer at Ultimate Software
profile.summary:
Application Developer, mainly for internet based applications. Acquaintance with a variety of Java frameworks and libraries, as well as C# and fictional languages like Scala and F#. Fast learner, always looking forward interesting projects that bring new opportunities to grow.

Specialties: Java, PHP, Javascript, XML, C++
